description: Lineage completeness validation for all provenance-blocked records. Validates source_id, parent lineage, acquisition origin, ingestion trace, and checksum availability. Validation only — no repair performed.

required_fields: parent_lineage — trace to upstream raw source or parent dataset
acquisition_origin — how/when the content was acquired

source_id_linked.detail: Source ID s5 is present in source_registry.json (StackExchange Code).

parent_lineage.detail: No parent lineage recorded. The record does not trace back to a specific StackExchange post ID or dump file.
parent_lineage.required_for_compliance: CC-BY-SA-4.0 requires attribution per post, which requires knowing the specific post.

acquisition_origin.detail: No acquisition origin recorded. Not possible to determine how or when the content was extracted from StackExchange.
acquisition_origin.required_for_compliance: Need acquisition timestamp to confirm CC-BY-SA-4.0 version applicability.

ingestion_trace.detail: No processing pipeline steps recorded. The transformations applied to the StackExchange source are unknown.
ingestion_trace.required_for_compliance: CC-BY-SA-4.0 requires indicating if content was modified/adapted.

checksum_availability.detail: No content checksum is available for this record in engine_checksums.json or similar.
checksum_availability.required_for_compliance: Checksum needed for content integrity verification across revision cycles.

completeness.reason: Only source_id linkage is established. All other lineage trace fields (parent, acquisition, ingestion, checksum) are absent.

source_id_linked.detail: Source ID h3 is present in source_registry.json (WikiChip).

parent_lineage.detail: No parent lineage recorded. Cannot trace to specific WikiChip article.
parent_lineage.required_for_compliance: Attribution requires knowing the specific article URL and title.

acquisition_origin.required_for_compliance: Need to confirm when content was acquired to verify license version.

ingestion_trace.required_for_compliance: Must document if content was modified.

completeness.reason: Only source_id linkage is established. All other lineage trace fields are absent. License also carries '(verify)' appendix needing human confirmation.

common_gaps: acquisition_origin — no acquisition timestamp or method
summary.source_registry_linkage: Both records have valid source_id links to source_registry.json
summary.source_registry_status_note: Both source entries (s5, h3) have status='review' — they have NOT been formally accepted. This is a separate upstream blocker.
